summary: The uri module interacts with HTTP/HTTPS services, supports Digest, Basic and WSSE auth, and returns headers in lowercase; Windows uses win_uri.
questions: How do I call a REST API from Ansible?
Why are response headers lowercase in uri results?
How do I call web services from Windows hosts?

answer_card.title: Call web services with uri
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.uri` talks to HTTP/HTTPS APIs with Digest, Basic or WSSE auth. Response headers are returned **lowercase**. Windows: `ansible.windows.win_uri`.
